name: payment-links
title: Payments with Stripe Payment Links
about:
Take payments and donations through the Payment Links you create in your Stripe dashboard. Add each link in the plugin settings with a label and whether it is a payment or a donation, then show it as a button with the theme partial the plugin page gives you. The button links straight to Stripe, with no script on your pages.
Point a Stripe webhook at /p/payment-links/webhook on your site for checkout.session.completed and checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, and give the plugin a restricted key that can read events and checkout sessions. The plugin keeps only the event id from the posted body and fetches the event from Stripe itself, so it records only payments Stripe confirms. Each new payment is logged once and can send you an email.
Limits: no carts, products, tax, subscriptions or refunds. Payments are kept for 24 months by default, then deleted. A CSV export too large for one file asks for a month range.
features: Payment and donation buttons from your Stripe Payment Links
Plain link buttons, no script on your pages
Only payments Stripe confirms are recorded, once each
An email to you for every payment
Payments log with totals per month and CSV export
Payments deleted after the retention period you set
